messages.subject: automatically deselect checkboxInput
parts:
Would you please point me to an example of how to set up two mutually exclusive checkboxInput boxes?

say:

      checkboxInput("gender.male", label="Male", value=FALSE)
      ,
      checkboxInput("gender.female", label="Female", value=TRUE)

where if I select Male, then Female is automatically de-selected.

many thanks!

Patrick.

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: automatically deselect checkboxInput
parts:
Thanks Jurgen,

I'm new to shiny and I hadn't tried the radioButtons before. Thanks for pointing them out.

The radioButtons are very close to what I was looking for and I'm sure I'll soon get to use them.

If I understand correctly, with radioButtons one option MUST be selected. If I set 'selected' = NULL, the first button is selected by default. I would like the default to be no button selected at all. So it's not a yes/no world but a yes/no/no-opinion world.

A minor point is that the radioButtons are round so when they are aligned with checkboxInput, which are square, they stand out a bit. Just a remark in passing because that's not a big problem.

I wander if the radioButtons can be tweaked to show no selection as default?

The alternative I was going to explore was to have a variable, say 'state' that would be either TRUE or FALSE and to toggle

     checkboxInput("binary", label="I like it awfully much", value=state)
    ,

     checkboxInput("binary", label="I like it rather", value=!state)

with something like reactive wrapped around. But anticipating that I would get stuck in a dead-end, I thought I should ask here first!

Thanks.
